39c38ddb-450c-8192-a2a0-e73ad66f764f.title: EMIXAR Continuum
39c38ddb-450c-8192-a2a0-e73ad66f764f.excerpt: Munich studio govar GmbH merges physical artworks and virtual creations in a shared space to explore extended reality as an emotional art form.
39c38ddb-450c-8192-a2a0-e73ad66f764f.excerptZh: 慕尼黑 govar GmbH 工作室将实体艺术与虚拟创作融于共享空间，探索扩展现实的情感表达。

39c38ddb-450c-8107-b135-f97abec9b273.title: Airy
39c38ddb-450c-8107-b135-f97abec9b273.excerpt: Two robotic arms manipulate silk to project a forest while the room’s atmosphere shifts between clear skies and storms based on their synchronized movements.
39c38ddb-450c-8107-b135-f97abec9b273.excerptZh: 两只机械臂操纵丝绸投射森林景象，房间气氛随同步动作在晴朗与风暴之间转换。

39a38ddb-450c-813a-b64c-fa42b2dcc425.title: Qwen Stefani Against Techfascism
39a38ddb-450c-813a-b64c-fa42b2dcc425.excerpt: Virtual influencer Qwen Stefani opposes techauthoritarianism and algorithmic control in this exhibition challenging the rise of techfascism in daily life.
39a38ddb-450c-813a-b64c-fa42b2dcc425.titleZh: Qwen Stefani 反对技术法西斯主义
39a38ddb-450c-813a-b64c-fa42b2dcc425.excerptZh: 虚拟网红 Qwen Stefani 反抗技术威权与算法控制，挑战技术法西斯主义在日常生活中的兴起。

39938ddb-450c-81fc-acbc-fbe65d24d91d.title: SynTact
39938ddb-450c-81fc-acbc-fbe65d24d91d.excerpt: Explore how Ricoh and Ars Electronica Futurelab enhance team creativity through interactive prototypes, AI systems, and more-than-human perspectives in this exhibition.
39938ddb-450c-81fc-acbc-fbe65d24d91d.excerptZh: 通过互动原型、AI 系统与超越人类的视角，探索理光和 Ars Electronica Futurelab 如何提升团队创造力。

39938ddb-450c-81fc-8930-d09b0a2ec08e.title: Noise of War
39938ddb-450c-81fc-8930-d09b0a2ec08e.excerpt: Hear the metallic, rough timbre of zinc organ pipes that replaced lead-tin alloys during the World Wars to manufacture ammunition.
39938ddb-450c-81fc-8930-d09b0a2ec08e.excerptZh: 聆听锌制管风琴音管粗粝的金属音色：世界大战期间，原有铅锡合金被用于制造弹药。

39838ddb-450c-81e2-9203-c63479dc976e.title: Colliding Counterparts
39838ddb-450c-81e2-9203-c63479dc976e.excerpt: Watch painted tiles rotate via quantum algorithms, visualizing invisible particle collisions through a grid of handmade, dual-sided artwork.
39838ddb-450c-81e2-9203-c63479dc976e.excerptZh: 观看手绘双面瓷砖在量子算法驱动下旋转，以网格形式呈现不可见的粒子碰撞。

39838ddb-450c-81c2-9085-e296ccfc05bb.title: Global Level of Confidence
39838ddb-450c-81c2-9085-e296ccfc05bb.excerpt: Use your webcam to search genetic records for parents disappeared during Argentina’s dictatorship in this interactive biometric exhibition.
39838ddb-450c-81c2-9085-e296ccfc05bb.excerptZh: 这件互动生物识别作品利用摄像头检索遗传记录，寻找阿根廷独裁时期失踪的父母。

39838ddb-450c-81b0-931e-e838bd5d6102.title: Wicked Mirror
39838ddb-450c-81b0-931e-e838bd5d6102.excerpt: Speak your mind and watch a photorealistic clone argue against you, challenging your assumptions on wicked problems in this interactive exhibition.
39838ddb-450c-81b0-931e-e838bd5d6102.excerptZh: 说出你的观点，看逼真的数字分身与你争辩，挑战你对复杂难题的预设。

39838ddb-450c-811a-bbb7-f7dfa824c778.title: Komorebi
39838ddb-450c-811a-bbb7-f7dfa824c778.excerpt: A swarm of artificial creatures creates spatial electronic music in response to the sun, clouds, and tree shadows moving in the wind.
39838ddb-450c-811a-bbb7-f7dfa824c778.excerptZh: 一群人工生物随阳光、云朵与风中树影的变化，生成空间电子音乐。

39838ddb-450c-81f7-accc-d7bd52ebd478.title: BADDANCEWITHTHEBADWEEDS
39838ddb-450c-81f7-accc-d7bd52ebd478.excerpt: Dance with THEBADWEEDS, a trans-species music group, to mutate your body and earn seeds of futures in this immersive installation.
39838ddb-450c-81f7-accc-d7bd52ebd478.excerptZh: 与跨物种乐团 THEBADWEEDS 共舞，在沉浸式装置中改变身体，收获未来的种子。

39738ddb-450c-8122-97c1-e540d7d02aae.title: Entre barros y fragmentos
39738ddb-450c-8122-97c1-e540d7d02aae.excerpt: Interweave archives, AI, and Moche ceramics to question colonial systems regarding the classification of bodies and gender in this decolonial artistic research project.
39738ddb-450c-8122-97c1-e540d7d02aae.excerptZh: 将档案、AI 与莫切陶器交织，通过去殖民艺术研究质疑殖民体系对身体与性别的分类。

39738ddb-450c-8199-a6be-e8d963107d59.title: Sinécdoque
39738ddb-450c-8199-a6be-e8d963107d59.excerpt: Olmedo combines pneumatic systems and prosthetic materials with medical devices to explore sustaining life through artificial organs.
39738ddb-450c-8199-a6be-e8d963107d59.excerptZh: Olmedo 将气动系统、假体材料与医疗设备结合，探索通过人工器官维持生命。

39738ddb-450c-81af-9c94-eb06c5647033.title: OYA
39738ddb-450c-81af-9c94-eb06c5647033.excerpt: Watch archival and new footage of dancer Black Pearl de Almeida Lima in this 13-minute mixed-reality installation about embodied transition.
39738ddb-450c-81af-9c94-eb06c5647033.excerptZh: 这件13分钟混合现实装置结合舞者 Black Pearl de Almeida Lima 的档案与新影像，探索身体化的转变。

39738ddb-450c-8157-b7a9-eb297f68703b.title: GUSEN CONVOLUTE
39738ddb-450c-8157-b7a9-eb297f68703b.excerpt: Witness art by Peter Androsch based on secret songs written by Polish musicians imprisoned and tortured to death in the Gusen concentration camps.
39738ddb-450c-8157-b7a9-eb297f68703b.excerptZh: Peter Androsch 以秘密歌曲为基础创作，这些歌曲出自被囚禁并虐杀于古森集中营的波兰音乐家。

39738ddb-450c-80f2-ae0e-e1d0be79bdc5.title: Metally Meadows
39738ddb-450c-80f2-ae0e-e1d0be79bdc5.excerpt: Touch metal grass wires in this sound installation that mimics a field, offering a unique tactile experience and shared discovery without the softness of…
39738ddb-450c-80f2-ae0e-e1d0be79bdc5.excerptZh: 触摸模拟草地的金属丝，在声音装置中体验独特触感与共同发现；这里没有草的柔软。

39738ddb-450c-81ef-960b-f6172d92f2aa.title: ZUSAMMEN ODER GETRENNT?
39738ddb-450c-81ef-960b-f6172d92f2aa.excerpt: God’s Entertainment presents a fictional election campaign in public posters to explore the us against them principle and political exclusion.
39738ddb-450c-81ef-960b-f6172d92f2aa.excerptZh: God’s Entertainment 通过公共海报展开虚构竞选，探讨“我们对他们”的逻辑与政治排斥。

39738ddb-450c-818e-98f4-c9107a9e2916.title: The Rhinoceros in the Room
39738ddb-450c-818e-98f4-c9107a9e2916.excerpt: An exhibition explores Eugène Ionesco’s play Rhinoceros, examining conformity and authoritarianism through the metaphor of metamorphosis into rhinoceroses.
39738ddb-450c-818e-98f4-c9107a9e2916.excerptZh: 以 Eugène Ionesco 的戏剧《犀牛》为出发点，通过变成犀牛的隐喻探讨从众与威权主义。

39638ddb-450c-818a-9119-ebe49538e40f.title: Mechanical Kurds
39638ddb-450c-818a-9119-ebe49538e40f.excerpt: Hito Steyerl reveals the hidden human labor behind digital platforms by reactivating the historical figure of the Turk in this critical exhibition.
39638ddb-450c-818a-9119-ebe49538e40f.excerptZh: Hito Steyerl 重新激活历史上的“土耳其行棋傀儡”形象，揭示数字平台背后隐藏的人类劳动。

39638ddb-450c-8181-8de3-e0a9e20f3610.title: The Fragiles
39638ddb-450c-8181-8de3-e0a9e20f3610.excerpt: Metal tentacles with speakers surround you as Barbara Kapusta narrates an apocalyptic science fiction story about community history and corporate power.
39638ddb-450c-8181-8de3-e0a9e20f3610.excerptZh: 带有扬声器的金属触手环绕观众，Barbara Kapusta 讲述有关共同体历史与企业权力的末日科幻故事。

39638ddb-450c-819b-bbd2-eb25aeb468d4.title: Wavering in Warmth
39638ddb-450c-819b-bbd2-eb25aeb468d4.excerpt: Watch a square frame of shape memory alloy curve into 3D sculpture as it absorbs radiant heat from the lighting.
39638ddb-450c-819b-bbd2-eb25aeb468d4.excerptZh: 观看形状记忆合金方框吸收灯光辐射热，弯曲成为三维雕塑。

39638ddb-450c-8107-8f09-f452348db25c.title: Drops into Being
39638ddb-450c-8107-8f09-f452348db25c.excerpt: Watch water droplets generate electricity that transforms into light and sound, revealing how matter becomes fragile energy.
39638ddb-450c-8107-8f09-f452348db25c.excerptZh: 水滴产生电力，再转化为光与声，呈现物质如何成为脆弱的能量。

39638ddb-450c-814b-8f9b-f2e1a9441977.title: Forest Ecosomatics
39638ddb-450c-814b-8f9b-f2e1a9441977.excerpt: Touch rivers and moss via wearable interfaces that translate plant responses into sonic-haptic feedback, reshaping human-nature relationships.
39638ddb-450c-814b-8f9b-f2e1a9441977.excerptZh: 通过可穿戴界面触碰河流与苔藓，将植物反应转化为声音和触觉反馈，重塑人与自然的关系。

39638ddb-450c-81ec-bf6d-cfe0c08669b2.title: Mirror to the Soul
39638ddb-450c-81ec-bf6d-cfe0c08669b2.excerpt: Step into a multi-sensorial installation where light, shadow, and sound guide your introspective journey through the hidden dimensions of the self.
39638ddb-450c-81ec-bf6d-cfe0c08669b2.excerptZh: 进入由光、影与声音组成的多感官装置，向内探索自我的隐秘维度。

39638ddb-450c-81c4-b190-efa0ff7c73a0.title: Spot On
39638ddb-450c-81c4-b190-efa0ff7c73a0.excerpt: Sit on a stool in a white room while a multimodal AI analyzes your image to deliver a live, real-time psychological reading of your…
39638ddb-450c-81c4-b190-efa0ff7c73a0.excerptZh: 坐在白色房间的凳子上，让多模态 AI 分析你的影像，并实时给出心理解读。

39638ddb-450c-812d-8050-dcf97f828d90.title: Operation Sunken Sea
39638ddb-450c-812d-8050-dcf97f828d90.excerpt: Heba Y. Amin’s exhibition exposes political and ecological violence in techno-utopian visions through historical geo-engineering fantasies like the Atlantropa project.
39638ddb-450c-812d-8050-dcf97f828d90.excerptZh: Heba Y. Amin 借助“大西洋乌托邦”等历史地球工程幻想，揭示技术乌托邦愿景中的政治与生态暴力。

39538ddb-450c-811e-94c2-fb100285dfea.title: What the Record Forgot
39538ddb-450c-811e-94c2-fb100285dfea.excerpt: Hear sounds, watch videos, and view 3D surrogates via AR in empty bell-jar vitrines staging colonial epistemic violence through absence.
39538ddb-450c-811e-94c2-fb100285dfea.excerptZh: 在空置钟罩展柜中，通过 AR 聆听声音、观看影像与三维替身，以缺席呈现殖民知识暴力。

39538ddb-450c-81bf-abb7-e0243be0cc61.title: Echoes of the Abyss
39538ddb-450c-81bf-abb7-e0243be0cc61.excerpt: This exhibition explores the toxic legacy of dumped chemical munitions and unexploded ordnance reshaping marine ecosystems long after conflicts end.
39538ddb-450c-81bf-abb7-e0243be0cc61.excerptZh: 探索倾倒的化学弹药与未爆弹药留下的有毒遗产，以及它们在冲突结束后对海洋生态的长期影响。

39538ddb-450c-81d5-a96d-e371715b0437.title: RÍOS TRILOGY
39538ddb-450c-81d5-a96d-e371715b0437.excerpt: An installation exploring the Amazon Basin through hydrology, language, and GIS data to examine socio-environmental challenges and territorial definitions.
39538ddb-450c-81d5-a96d-e371715b0437.excerptZh: 通过水文、语言与地理信息系统数据探索亚马孙流域，审视社会环境挑战及领土定义。

39538ddb-450c-819a-966c-f91ddfa22fb5.title: Trinity-Tarot-Garden
39538ddb-450c-819a-966c-f91ddfa22fb5.excerpt: Wear XR glasses to explore a shared, social experience of a threefold Tarot system blending real and virtual spaces in this immersive exhibition.
39538ddb-450c-819a-966c-f91ddfa22fb5.excerptZh: 戴上 XR 眼镜，在融合现实与虚拟的空间中，共同体验三重塔罗体系。

39538ddb-450c-810e-99e9-c6be3088c1c8.title: Show Me Your Face: The Power of Becoming
39538ddb-450c-810e-99e9-c6be3088c1c8.excerpt: This two-channel video installation explores the interplay between biology and experience, challenging deterministic narratives about human behavior and violence through
39538ddb-450c-810e-99e9-c6be3088c1c8.titleZh: 让我看见你的脸：生成的力量
39538ddb-450c-810e-99e9-c6be3088c1c8.excerptZh: 双通道影像装置探索生物学与经历的互动，挑战关于人类行为和暴力的决定论叙事。

39438ddb-450c-8138-bc15-db805c18820f.title: jakmile ladíme
39438ddb-450c-8138-bc15-db805c18820f.excerpt: Touch wrinkled membranes to hear fermented voices and microbial mumbling in this vibroacoustic exhibition blending Asturian blood fermentation with laboratory precision.
39438ddb-450c-8138-bc15-db805c18820f.excerptZh: 触摸褶皱薄膜，聆听发酵的声音与微生物呢喃；作品结合阿斯图里亚斯血液发酵与实验室精密技术。

39438ddb-450c-81c0-8484-f792653c9a49.title: CHIMERIA
39438ddb-450c-81c0-8484-f792653c9a49.excerpt: CHIMERIA transplants the eye to a camera and HMD, dismantling the body schema so volunteers can experience rebirth as a Chimera.
39438ddb-450c-81c0-8484-f792653c9a49.excerptZh: 将视觉移植到摄像头与头戴显示器，打破身体图式，让志愿者体验作为嵌合体重生。

39338ddb-450c-810c-a82c-c22747b9c0c2.title: Future Screenshots
39338ddb-450c-810c-a82c-c22747b9c0c2.excerpt: Interact with hanging paper phone screens to co-create shared futures and resist political inevitability in this activist-led installation.
39338ddb-450c-810c-a82c-c22747b9c0c2.excerptZh: 与悬挂的纸质手机屏幕互动，共同创造未来；这件由行动者主导的装置抵抗政治的“必然性”。

39338ddb-450c-8199-b6ab-fe56a66edf93.title: Open World
39338ddb-450c-8199-b6ab-fe56a66edf93.excerpt: A robotic dog avatar guides a boy through his childhood neighborhood, reconnecting him with memories of his homeland after fleeing the Russian invasion.
39338ddb-450c-8199-b6ab-fe56a66edf93.excerptZh: 机器狗化身带领一名逃离俄罗斯入侵的男孩重访童年街区，重新连接家园记忆。

39238ddb-450c-816e-a67d-c850c37d7b5c.title: Ambient (Re-)sourcing
39238ddb-450c-816e-a67d-c850c37d7b5c.excerpt: Three installations by xlab respond to ambient heat and moisture, inviting visitors to attune to subtle forces circulating through living systems.
39238ddb-450c-816e-a67d-c850c37d7b5c.excerptZh: xlab 的三件装置回应环境温度与湿度，邀请观众感知生命系统中流动的细微力量。

39138ddb-450c-81f7-a684-d4e6111a0e12.title: Office for Tree Migration (OTM)
39138ddb-450c-81f7-a684-d4e6111a0e12.excerpt: Agnes Meyer-Brandis investigates tree migration through custom software and ecological monitoring to help plants escape climate change.
39138ddb-450c-81f7-a684-d4e6111a0e12.excerptZh: Agnes Meyer-Brandis 利用定制软件与生态监测研究树木迁徙，帮助植物逃离气候变化。

39138ddb-450c-8117-8bf7-da8c0f89b83a.title: Counter-Cartographies of Resistance
39138ddb-450c-8117-8bf7-da8c0f89b83a.excerpt: An immersive textile installation uses video mapping to convey healing messages from Mapuche machi Millaray Melinao in Mapuzungún.
39138ddb-450c-8117-8bf7-da8c0f89b83a.excerptZh: 沉浸式织物装置通过影像映射，传达马普切治疗者 Millaray Melinao 以马普切语发出的疗愈讯息。

39138ddb-450c-80c5-b26c-e778b1990590.title: CHIT-CHAT not bot
39138ddb-450c-80c5-b26c-e778b1990590.excerpt: Hakuhodo and Ars Electronica showcase their thirteenth year of Art Thinking research exploring the relationship between people and technology.
39138ddb-450c-80c5-b26c-e778b1990590.excerptZh: 博报堂与 Ars Electronica 展示第十三年的“艺术思维”研究，探索人与科技的关系。

39038ddb-450c-8178-86d9-fcd75be38abf.title: Where is everybody?
39038ddb-450c-8178-86d9-fcd75be38abf.excerpt: Analog TVs display AI video and cosmic static to explore the Fermi Paradox and the potential disappearance of technological intelligence.
39038ddb-450c-8178-86d9-fcd75be38abf.excerptZh: 模拟电视播放 AI 影像与宇宙静电噪声，探索费米悖论及技术智能可能的消失。

39038ddb-450c-8107-b262-f06afe5f9191.title: Bubble Talk
39038ddb-450c-8107-b262-f06afe5f9191.excerpt: Create a personalized museum guide using AI that adapts to your interests and curiosity in this experimental prototype by Ars Electronica and Toyota.
39038ddb-450c-8107-b262-f06afe5f9191.excerptZh: 体验 Ars Electronica 与丰田的实验原型，利用 AI 创建适应个人兴趣与好奇心的博物馆导览。

39038ddb-450c-81d1-90d4-c17b9c5597ef.title: Hard Times – Soft Sounds
39038ddb-450c-81d1-90d4-c17b9c5597ef.excerpt: Motor-driven water-filled seashells create fragile, ASMR-inspired tones, transforming oceanic objects into an intimate ecological sound instrument.
39038ddb-450c-81d1-90d4-c17b9c5597ef.excerptZh: 电机驱动装水的贝壳，产生受 ASMR 启发的细微音色，将海洋物体变为亲密的生态乐器。

38f38ddb-450c-8177-8164-c1b8b95920c4.title: Dog’s Nose
38f38ddb-450c-8177-8164-c1b8b95920c4.excerpt: Follow a dog’s route along a map, sniffing red dots to experience its unique smellscape recorded via real-time molecular analysis technology.
38f38ddb-450c-8177-8164-c1b8b95920c4.excerptZh: 沿地图追踪狗的路线，嗅闻红点，体验通过实时分子分析记录的独特气味景观。

38f38ddb-450c-81ac-a236-f0e4ef957bae.title: Olfactory Biome
38f38ddb-450c-81ac-a236-f0e4ef957bae.excerpt: Wear scents to become a moth or bat in this nocturnal forest installation where movement shifts the soundscape and chemical signals drive communication.
38f38ddb-450c-81ac-a236-f0e4ef957bae.excerptZh: 佩戴气味化身飞蛾或蝙蝠，进入夜间森林装置；移动改变声景，化学信号驱动交流。

38e38ddb-450c-815b-b5cd-c954a78d503b.title: Deer Hunter
38e38ddb-450c-815b-b5cd-c954a78d503b.excerpt: A hybrid documentary uses archival footage and generative AI to examine masculinity and migration through an artist’s family history between Italy and the US.
38e38ddb-450c-815b-b5cd-c954a78d503b.excerptZh: 混合纪录片结合档案影像与生成式 AI，通过艺术家在意大利与美国之间的家族史审视男性气质与迁徙。

38d38ddb-450c-81a2-b031-e5c2db6d7e50.title: Canvas
38d38ddb-450c-81a2-b031-e5c2db6d7e50.excerpt: Close-up photographs of skin reveal how gender inequality and legal structures restrict women’s autonomy, turning the body into a living archive of experience.
38d38ddb-450c-81a2-b031-e5c2db6d7e50.excerptZh: 皮肤特写呈现性别不平等与法律结构如何限制女性自主权，将身体化为经验的活档案。

38c38ddb-450c-8155-8b17-f0135a765464.title: Network Gong Ensemble Archive
38c38ddb-450c-8155-8b17-f0135a765464.excerpt: Hear generative patterns unique to Southeast Asian sound cultures in this networked communal sonic experience and experimental auditory archive.

38b38ddb-450c-8123-adb9-e450242d00bf.title: Smart Skin Farm

38a38ddb-450c-8161-91fe-e0a75c9e36c3.title: Rewire

38a38ddb-450c-81a8-856d-f2a8d543ac71.title: G.A.U.D.I.

38a38ddb-450c-8128-8fc2-d08734ac989d.title: resurrection 2.0

38a38ddb-450c-8157-9dbd-c1a1f31b9ff9.title: Chorusing Symbionts

38a38ddb-450c-8157-9dbd-c1a1f31b9ff9.excerptZh: 公共花园中的人工声学生物生成空间电子音乐，邀请听众想象新的生物与人工共生关系。

38a38ddb-450c-8133-b6da-ef7a40155be8.title: As Gems in Metal: Face 002

38838ddb-450c-80fc-be2e-cd749e914df2.title: Ars Electronica Center Façade

39e38ddb-450c-8117-8441-fe16eb8078e1.title: Synthetic Spirits

39e38ddb-450c-810f-af25-d4be5f317215.title: I Love You, Customer

39138ddb-450c-8182-bbde-ef5d43827e16.title: Tuesday I Became Clouds

39138ddb-450c-81fc-8f17-eec2fcaf754f.title: (A)I love you, we’re the same

39138ddb-450c-8136-a8d4-c9698211ea02.title: untitled, unformed

38e38ddb-450c-81e8-a03b-e43d3d886efe.title: Playthings of Touch

38e38ddb-450c-8110-8315-f8265bdea61d.title: Migraine Machine

38b38ddb-450c-8167-b6d1-c693f46c23da.title: Practices of Transformation

38a38ddb-450c-8144-b1d9-f1c12730a207.title: The Critic

38838ddb-450c-817a-9d62-c89594139fc7.title: I think it was Nervous too

38738ddb-450c-81ae-bb31-d403869a0289.title: Glitchaelia

38238ddb-450c-8110-af78-ef62cc52017d.title: Becoming Space

38238ddb-450c-81ea-8cdb-e8c0d36bcaed.title: Touch Our Scar

38238ddb-450c-81db-b456-d059bd1c1dba.title: KARMA

38238ddb-450c-8158-9265-fb41a7e55298.title: The Unseen Realm

37c38ddb-450c-8168-8126-f6f3451258ca.title: BAR BAR

37c38ddb-450c-81ca-b62a-e7972240e8d5.title: CompactSun vol.3
37c38ddb-450c-81ca-b62a-e7972240e8d5.excerpt: A giant sphere of 1008 CDs projects sunstorm footage, turning the room into a glaring sea of light for this tribute to obsolete storage…

37c38ddb-450c-813c-8913-de416cd8effc.title: Placenta
37c38ddb-450c-813c-8913-de416cd8effc.excerpt: A sculpture invites you to dissolve into silence and peace, offering a safe haven to slow down and reconnect with your true self.
37c38ddb-450c-813c-8913-de416cd8effc.excerptZh: 雕塑邀请你融入寂静与安宁，在安全的庇护中慢下来，重新连接真实自我。

37c38ddb-450c-81d7-806d-f71e53a69c5f.title: City Soundscape
37c38ddb-450c-81d7-806d-f71e53a69c5f.excerpt: Touch twelve hexagonal facets to trigger location-specific field recordings that increase in volume as you interact with the geometric installation.
37c38ddb-450c-81d7-806d-f71e53a69c5f.excerptZh: 触摸十二个六边形表面，触发不同地点的实地录音；声音随互动逐渐增强。

37c38ddb-450c-8174-9a67-c05686b23164.title: AYBABTU
37c38ddb-450c-8174-9a67-c05686b23164.excerpt: A sound sculpture that shifts from chaotic noise to clear musical themes as you move closer, revealing different compositions from every angle.
37c38ddb-450c-8174-9a67-c05686b23164.excerptZh: 随着靠近，混乱噪声逐渐变成清晰旋律；从不同角度可听到不同构成。

37c38ddb-450c-8191-9b06-c5d3f6fafc4e.title: Hello, how are you?
37c38ddb-450c-8191-9b06-c5d3f6fafc4e.excerpt: This performance uses movement and live sound to stretch the phrase Hello, how are you? until it feels hollow, reflecting on hollow social connections.
37c38ddb-450c-8191-9b06-c5d3f6fafc4e.excerptZh: 动作与现场声音不断拉长这句问候，直到它显得空洞，映照空泛的社会联系。

37c38ddb-450c-8138-88b1-d00f36e306f7.title: Stille Okkupantin
37c38ddb-450c-8138-88b1-d00f36e306f7.excerpt: Interact gently with this silent occupant’s home, a deadly trap hidden in the spaces you touch, inviting you to admire its invisible work.
37c38ddb-450c-8138-88b1-d00f36e306f7.excerptZh: 轻轻触碰这位沉默住客的家，发现藏于接触空间中的致命陷阱，欣赏其无形工作。

37c38ddb-450c-81c8-b50e-f4ab68b72edb.title: Δύο χέρια (Two Hands)
37c38ddb-450c-81c8-b50e-f4ab68b72edb.excerpt: Hand-finish 600 frames with watercolors and quill ink to visualize Greek love dimensions through synchronized analog animation loops.
37c38ddb-450c-81c8-b50e-f4ab68b72edb.excerptZh: 600帧以水彩与羽毛笔墨手工完成的同步模拟动画，呈现希腊语中爱的不同维度。

37c38ddb-450c-81b6-a1c9-d912130b116e.title: Cyb3rD4wg5
37c38ddb-450c-81b6-a1c9-d912130b116e.excerpt: Cyb3rD4wg5 offers four arm attachments to grab unlimited hotdogs, helping you transcend your flesh-prison and reach your post-human potential.
37c38ddb-450c-81b6-a1c9-d912130b116e.excerptZh: 四条附加手臂帮助你抓取无限热狗，超越肉身牢笼，释放后人类潜能。

37c38ddb-450c-81b5-b678-e029ac9f8059.title: GTB - VIE
37c38ddb-450c-81b5-b678-e029ac9f8059.excerpt: Navigate a sensory journey between Gothenburg and Vienna forests, deciding when to travel back and forth in this long-distance relationship exhibition.
37c38ddb-450c-81b5-b678-e029ac9f8059.excerptZh: 在两地森林之间展开感官旅程，自行决定往返时刻，体验远距离关系。

37c38ddb-450c-8128-baa4-f207244a0ea8.title: Who is jumping, Jack?
37c38ddb-450c-8128-baa4-f207244a0ea8.excerpt: Your arm movements trigger servo-controlled corkscrews in real time, blurring the line between human performer and mechanical reflection in this kinetic installation.
37c38ddb-450c-8128-baa4-f207244a0ea8.excerptZh: 手臂动作实时触发伺服控制的开瓶器，模糊人类表演者与机械映像的界限。

37c38ddb-450c-81ba-aa9c-ee932a7f002f.title: dare not to know
37c38ddb-450c-81ba-aa9c-ee932a7f002f.excerpt: Test your knowledge in this educational game where shocking facts about reproductive health and human rights are felt physically, not just read.
37c38ddb-450c-81ba-aa9c-ee932a7f002f.excerptZh: 在教育游戏中测试知识，用身体感受关于生殖健康与人权的惊人事实。

37c38ddb-450c-81ea-b4c8-fdcd9ad3116d.title: Comments
37c38ddb-450c-81ea-b4c8-fdcd9ad3116d.excerpt: Scan QR codes on cards to hear social media comments that trigger particle visuals, revealing the psychological impact of cyberbullying.
37c38ddb-450c-81ea-b4c8-fdcd9ad3116d.excerptZh: 扫描卡片二维码，聆听社交媒体评论并触发粒子影像，揭示网络霸凌的心理影响。

37c38ddb-450c-8112-985b-da90838e7bbd.title: UNSEEN FREQUENCIES

37c38ddb-450c-8112-985b-da90838e7bbd.excerptZh: 显微镜下水熊虫与线虫实时运动，合成器将其动作转化为不断变化的声景。

37c38ddb-450c-8104-b5a7-ded8a394fbe5.title: Awakening Matter
37c38ddb-450c-8104-b5a7-ded8a394fbe5.excerpt: Step onto river stones on pedestals to feel them vibrate under your weight, revealing a tactile dialogue between human touch and inert geological material.
37c38ddb-450c-8104-b5a7-ded8a394fbe5.excerptZh: 踩上基座上的河石，感受重量触发的震动，体验人体与惰性地质材料的触觉对话。

37c38ddb-450c-8196-9988-f38313eea99a.title: Alphus Masculus
37c38ddb-450c-8196-9988-f38313eea99a.excerpt: An interactive artwork humorously critiques alpha male ideology by offering absurd tips to visitors who approach the character.
37c38ddb-450c-8196-9988-f38313eea99a.excerptZh: 互动角色向靠近的观众提供荒诞建议，以幽默批判“阿尔法男性”意识形态。

37c38ddb-450c-814d-b1f5-d99d871c8d4d.title: The Veil

37c38ddb-450c-814d-b1f5-d99d871c8d4d.excerptZh: 与锁子甲结构互动，通过声音和影像回应探索无意识。

37c38ddb-450c-81a2-b306-cce36e2838cf.title: A Bridge of Clouds

37c38ddb-450c-815f-a754-fa26dccd6bb0.title: My Invisible Processing
37c38ddb-450c-815f-a754-fa26dccd6bb0.excerpt: A self-typing keyboard and fingerprint-font screen invite visitors to pause and reflect on their own internal background processing.
37c38ddb-450c-815f-a754-fa26dccd6bb0.excerptZh: 自动打字键盘与指纹字体屏幕邀请观众暂停，反思自身内在的后台处理。

37c38ddb-450c-8190-a55c-d95270e2a054.title: Memories of a Distant City
37c38ddb-450c-8190-a55c-d95270e2a054.excerpt: Trace the shifting wounds and voices of a homeland through touch, matching fragmented news images to the distant city held in memory.
37c38ddb-450c-8190-a55c-d95270e2a054.excerptZh: 通过触摸追踪故土变化的伤痕与声音，将新闻碎片与记忆中的远方城市拼合。

37c38ddb-450c-810b-ad8c-c7a2cf8d5a2a.title: Fish (skin) & Chips
37c38ddb-450c-810b-ad8c-c7a2cf8d5a2a.excerpt: Touch and smell tanned salmon skins to explore how discarded fish waste transforms into durable, textured tapestries through material experiments.

37c38ddb-450c-8177-b268-ebe1d38f816c.title: NOISE •• RAUSCHEN
37c38ddb-450c-8177-b268-ebe1d38f816c.excerpt: Experience sensory overload through real-time generative video and sound that oscillates between documentation and abstraction in this immersive exhibition.
37c38ddb-450c-8177-b268-ebe1d38f816c.excerptZh: 实时生成影像与声音在记录和抽象之间摆动，营造感官过载的沉浸体验。

37c38ddb-450c-8115-aac0-c65ab733c309.title: index:none

37c38ddb-450c-8174-945e-f3d9d51115eb.title: Circular of Thought

37c38ddb-450c-8163-aa99-d5bf95d0e7d5.title: La Tourelle

37c38ddb-450c-81df-9346-eb79d449ae9a.title: Ferro Dynamics

37c38ddb-450c-81d9-a3f0-e4aaf2f8464c.title: Residual Time: Smoke

37c38ddb-450c-8122-a2f1-d0dac977e5e9.title: 游戏/Play

37c38ddb-450c-81ef-9fbf-f2ddc3d684ac.title: Who Speaks for Me

37c38ddb-450c-81df-976d-ce7ce3640280.title: By the Time We Looked

37c38ddb-450c-8186-970f-dc0e8cb09971.title: Collective Instrument of Maintenance
37c38ddb-450c-8186-970f-dc0e8cb09971.excerpt: Adjust tension lines together in this interactive sound sculpture to transform noise into resonance, making the invisible labor of earthworms physically and audibly
37c38ddb-450c-8186-970f-dc0e8cb09971.excerptZh: 共同调整拉线张力，让噪声转为共鸣，以可触、可听的方式呈现蚯蚓隐形的劳动。

37c38ddb-450c-810c-b355-ca971dff8b33.title: veronica

37c38ddb-450c-8183-9a41-cac22e78f6a1.title: Mío##

37c38ddb-450c-815e-9017-fd302c869080.title: BioCore

37c38ddb-450c-8118-89cf-fdfa224a7d06.title: in/affection

37c38ddb-450c-8143-a02f-df4eac22dc47.title: Phantom Limbs

37c38ddb-450c-8158-a7ef-d22b1bc79035.title: Phobos

37b38ddb-450c-8195-b659-c02ab684394c.title: Relational Interactions
37b38ddb-450c-8195-b659-c02ab684394c.excerpt: Bauhaus-Universität Weimar artists and researchers propose a framework shifting attention from isolated computational systems to broader relational interactions.
37b38ddb-450c-8195-b659-c02ab684394c.excerptZh: 魏玛包豪斯大学的艺术家与研究者，将注意力从孤立计算系统转向更广泛的关系互动。

37b38ddb-450c-81f6-9ca5-ff4b1ff04d0b.title: Wide World & Small World
37b38ddb-450c-81f6-9ca5-ff4b1ff04d0b.excerpt: Hear synthetic voices from a cylindrical structure, blending art and literature through machine translation to create a dissonant, humorous, and serious soundscape.
37b38ddb-450c-81f6-9ca5-ff4b1ff04d0b.excerptZh: 圆柱结构发出合成语音，通过机器翻译融合艺术与文学，形成不和谐、幽默又严肃的声景。

37b38ddb-450c-8116-b812-f10df294c863.title: Reflections: Outer Space / Inner Space
37b38ddb-450c-8116-b812-f10df294c863.excerpt: This exhibition explores the link between external realities and inner consciousness, proposing reflection as a vital practice amid global uncertainty and rapid
37b38ddb-450c-8116-b812-f10df294c863.titleZh: 映照：外部空间／内在空间
37b38ddb-450c-8116-b812-f10df294c863.excerptZh: 探索外在现实与内在意识的联系，在全球不确定性中将反思视为重要实践。

37b38ddb-450c-8110-a522-dd415d3d3087.title: between-margaridas
37b38ddb-450c-8110-a522-dd415d3d3087.excerpt: A geolocated Google map merges daisy family flora with the resistance stories of Brazilian women facing environmental and cultural destruction.
37b38ddb-450c-8110-a522-dd415d3d3087.excerptZh: 地理定位地图将菊科植物与巴西女性抵抗环境和文化破坏的故事融合。

37b38ddb-450c-819f-bcb6-e93a67d8f807.title: Permeable
37b38ddb-450c-819f-bcb6-e93a67d8f807.excerpt: Mist dissolves boundaries between land and water, making the invisible threshold between two worlds tangible through light and water experimentation.
37b38ddb-450c-819f-bcb6-e93a67d8f807.excerptZh: 雾消融陆地与水的边界，通过光与水的实验，使两个世界间的无形门槛可被感知。

37b38ddb-450c-8192-965a-fef027c8d89b.title: Embodied AI
37b38ddb-450c-8192-965a-fef027c8d89b.excerpt: Watch an AI guide involuntary physical movements to create a hallucinated dance, exploring agency in a hybrid human-machine body.
37b38ddb-450c-8192-965a-fef027c8d89b.excerptZh: AI 引导非自主身体动作，生成幻觉般的舞蹈，探索人机混合身体的能动性。

37b38ddb-450c-814b-8176-c869324beb6e.title: 0.5–100 Hz
37b38ddb-450c-814b-8176-c869324beb6e.excerpt: Two participants wear EEG headsets while their brain activity controls shape-changing robots, making invisible neural connections visible through movement.
37b38ddb-450c-814b-8176-c869324beb6e.excerptZh: 两名参与者戴上脑电设备，以脑活动控制变形机器人，让隐形神经连接通过运动显现。

37b38ddb-450c-819c-ac0c-c3059e30bbf4.title: Mnemonic Epitaph
37b38ddb-450c-819c-ac0c-c3059e30bbf4.excerpt: An interactive system mimetically reassembles daily video fragments from 2025 to reconstruct memory and explore alternative expressions of artificial intelligence.
37b38ddb-450c-819c-ac0c-c3059e30bbf4.excerptZh: 互动系统模仿并重组2025年的日常影像碎片，重构记忆，探索 AI 的其他表达方式。

37b38ddb-450c-81de-9c5f-c6ae4307afb8.title: Pathology Inducing Machine
37b38ddb-450c-81de-9c5f-c6ae4307afb8.excerpt: Turn knobs and flip switches to physically disrupt a diffusion model, making AI generation unstable and contingent on your tactile human intervention.
37b38ddb-450c-81de-9c5f-c6ae4307afb8.excerptZh: 旋转旋钮、拨动开关，以触觉干预扰乱扩散模型，让 AI 生成变得不稳定。

37b38ddb-450c-8129-b0f8-f02c7aedd52f.title: Resonant Distances
37b38ddb-450c-8129-b0f8-f02c7aedd52f.excerpt: Interact with a social brain laboratory where neurotechnology reveals the hidden neural synchronization of empathy and co-presence between participants.
37b38ddb-450c-8129-b0f8-f02c7aedd52f.excerptZh: 在社会脑实验室中互动，通过神经技术观察共情与共同在场背后隐藏的神经同步。

37b38ddb-450c-81ee-a623-c03b91aa95df.title: On the Manner
37b38ddb-450c-81ee-a623-c03b91aa95df.excerpt: See semi-automated drawings and a hands-on demo as a robotic tool connects historical printmaking manuals with modern ideas about precision and reproduction.
37b38ddb-450c-81ee-a623-c03b91aa95df.excerptZh: 观看半自动绘画与动手演示，以机器人连接历史版画手册及现代精确性与复制观念。

37b38ddb-450c-81af-a580-f01ab46c0642.title: Speculative Bodies
37b38ddb-450c-81af-a580-f01ab46c0642.excerpt: An exhibition by University of Chicago students explores human-machine creativity as a site of friction where control gives way to contingency.
37b38ddb-450c-81af-a580-f01ab46c0642.excerptZh: 芝加哥大学学生将人机创造力视为摩擦发生之处，探索控制如何让位于偶然。

37b38ddb-450c-8105-ba03-f1b3ff04ebae.title: Reality Flux: Sensing the Unseen
37b38ddb-450c-8105-ba03-f1b3ff04ebae.excerpt: Inhabit next-gen existence in this exhibition where human-machine collaboration shapes reality through shifting embodiments and machinic systems.
37b38ddb-450c-8105-ba03-f1b3ff04ebae.excerptZh: 通过变化的身体形态与机器系统，探索人机协作如何塑造现实及未来存在方式。

37b38ddb-450c-8137-a5f2-d724654bfec3.title: Ex-Vivo
37b38ddb-450c-8137-a5f2-d724654bfec3.excerpt: Manipulate fabric strips to trigger LED lights in this interactive installation that translates CRISPR gene editing into a sensory experience.
37b38ddb-450c-8137-a5f2-d724654bfec3.excerptZh: 操作织物条触发 LED 灯，将 CRISPR 基因编辑转化为感官体验。

37b38ddb-450c-8176-9949-c0fb90482cbc.title: Remember I Was Carbohydrate
37b38ddb-450c-8176-9949-c0fb90482cbc.excerpt: Play this VR video game to reconsider your relationship with non-human entities like stones and trees in an Unreal Engine environment.
37b38ddb-450c-8176-9949-c0fb90482cbc.titleZh: 记得我曾是碳水化合物
37b38ddb-450c-8176-9949-c0fb90482cbc.excerptZh: 在虚幻引擎构建的 VR 游戏中，重新思考与石头、树木等非人类实体的关系。

37b38ddb-450c-814c-9e04-ca5268db3b95.title: MAMLAS-1
37b38ddb-450c-814c-9e04-ca5268db3b95.excerpt: Control a space rover with synthesizer-like interfaces to collect minerals, relying on imagination rather than a screen.
37b38ddb-450c-814c-9e04-ca5268db3b95.excerptZh: 使用类似合成器的界面控制太空车采集矿物，依靠想象而非屏幕。

37b38ddb-450c-81cb-b1f1-f969a4086715.title: 1KM
37b38ddb-450c-81cb-b1f1-f969a4086715.excerpt: Reproduce scrolling gestures to print a personal receipt while watching a shared archive of short videos projected onto a growing paper graveyard.
37b38ddb-450c-81cb-b1f1-f969a4086715.excerptZh: 重复滑动手势打印个人收据，观看短视频共享档案投射到不断增长的纸张墓地。

37b38ddb-450c-81c6-b55e-e3b6c2a24a55.title: Baram
37b38ddb-450c-81c6-b55e-e3b6c2a24a55.excerpt: Speak into a digital shrine where your voice becomes wind and light, weaving your meaning into a talisman among others’ wishes.
37b38ddb-450c-81c6-b55e-e3b6c2a24a55.excerptZh: 向数字神龛说话，让声音化为风与光，将自己的意义织入众人愿望中的护符。

37b38ddb-450c-81fc-bd40-ee0ad1af83df.title: Homo Eucalyptus
37b38ddb-450c-81fc-bd40-ee0ad1af83df.excerpt: This exhibition uses the koala’s ecological vulnerability to critique how human reliance on AI erodes our capacity for independent thought and agency.
37b38ddb-450c-81fc-bd40-ee0ad1af83df.excerptZh: 以考拉的生态脆弱性批判人类对 AI 的依赖如何侵蚀独立思考与行动能力。

37b38ddb-450c-8129-a4c4-fbb9b125432a.title: Remote Twins
37b38ddb-450c-8129-a4c4-fbb9b125432a.excerpt: Two robotic habitats monitor insects in nature and visualize their data in the gallery, letting visitors engage with invisible urban biodiversity.
37b38ddb-450c-8129-a4c4-fbb9b125432a.excerptZh: 两处机器人栖息地监测自然中的昆虫，并在展厅呈现数据，让观众接触隐形城市生物多样性。

37b38ddb-450c-811f-aed7-fe533e081a48.title: www.buy-a-toad.com
37b38ddb-450c-811f-aed7-fe533e081a48.excerpt: Buy a toad online to watch a human figure transform into data and leak away, exposing the violence of digital exploitation.
37b38ddb-450c-811f-aed7-fe533e081a48.excerptZh: 在线购买蟾蜍，观看人形转为数据并流失，揭露数字剥削的暴力。

37b38ddb-450c-818f-8962-e4d7a0896539.title: Manifestation
37b38ddb-450c-818f-8962-e4d7a0896539.excerpt: Sing to singing bowls and watch fiber-optic lights condense into tangible abundance in this ritual on shaping reality.
37b38ddb-450c-818f-8962-e4d7a0896539.excerptZh: 向颂钵歌唱，观看光纤灯凝聚为可感的丰盛，参与塑造现实的仪式。

37b38ddb-450c-8147-a843-cf90cfcc4cc6.title: Disappearance of Rituals
37b38ddb-450c-8147-a843-cf90cfcc4cc6.excerpt: SKKU presents five multisensory interactive experiences exploring how AI-driven services reshape digital rituals and invisible routines in daily life.
37b38ddb-450c-8147-a843-cf90cfcc4cc6.excerptZh: 成均馆大学以五件多感官互动体验，探索 AI 服务如何改变数字仪式与日常隐形惯例。

37b38ddb-450c-81dc-a50d-cbec62ce9664.title: Corporeal Resonance
37b38ddb-450c-81dc-a50d-cbec62ce9664.excerpt: Control sound with your body. This interactive synthesizer uses cameras to track head tilts, hand movements, and mouth openness for creative audio manipulation.
37b38ddb-450c-81dc-a50d-cbec62ce9664.excerptZh: 摄像头追踪头部倾斜、手部动作与张口幅度，让身体控制互动合成器的声音。

37b38ddb-450c-8142-a463-c02c1e7803c4.title: Chromesthesia
37b38ddb-450c-8142-a463-c02c1e7803c4.excerpt: Paint with colored markers to trigger distinct sounds, or layer musical shapes with tiles in this inclusive, sensory exhibition for all visitors.
37b38ddb-450c-8142-a463-c02c1e7803c4.excerptZh: 用彩色笔绘画触发不同声音，或以拼块叠加音乐形状，参与包容性的感官体验。

37b38ddb-450c-8198-bf39-d864b8ce2396.title: Ephemeral Sounds of the Gulf
37b38ddb-450c-8198-bf39-d864b8ce2396.excerpt: Listen to biodegradable vinyl records made from Gulf biomaterials that explore plastic pollution and the ephemerality of sound in digital culture.
37b38ddb-450c-8198-bf39-d864b8ce2396.excerptZh: 聆听海湾生物材料制成的可降解唱片，探索塑料污染与数字文化中声音的短暂性。

37b38ddb-450c-81e4-b22d-c26e13fdf425.title: Action & Effect
37b38ddb-450c-81e4-b22d-c26e13fdf425.excerpt: Vibrating water shaped by data and audience interaction visualizes gastrulation, the critical embryonic moment dividing into three layers that define future life.
37b38ddb-450c-81e4-b22d-c26e13fdf425.excerptZh: 数据与观众互动塑造震动的水，呈现胚胎原肠形成时分化为三层的关键生命阶段。

37b38ddb-450c-8164-a014-ca78625bb154.title: Bloom
37b38ddb-450c-8164-a014-ca78625bb154.excerpt: Watch motorized gears drive parametric petals designed by students using generative tools in this mechanical exhibition of motion and structure.
37b38ddb-450c-8164-a014-ca78625bb154.excerptZh: 电动齿轮驱动学生用生成工具设计的参数化花瓣，展示运动与结构。

37b38ddb-450c-8149-9808-fbe6b791bd1c.title: Alternative Frequencies
37b38ddb-450c-8149-9808-fbe6b791bd1c.excerpt: Four projects explore how media translations alter meaning, including Chromesthesia, which re-encodes visual information into sound for visitors to hear.
37b38ddb-450c-8149-9808-fbe6b791bd1c.excerptZh: 四个项目探索媒介翻译如何改变意义，包括将视觉信息重新编码为声音的《色听联觉》。

37b38ddb-450c-8171-97e3-dbce6d7143ce.title: AGCT
37b38ddb-450c-8171-97e3-dbce6d7143ce.excerpt: Watch DNA letters replicate on transparent displays while a slot machine introduces lifestyle factors that trigger genetic mutations across generations.
37b38ddb-450c-8171-97e3-dbce6d7143ce.excerptZh: 观看 DNA 字母在透明屏幕复制，老虎机引入生活方式因素，触发跨代基因突变。

37b38ddb-450c-8186-9cbd-f07f1245b795.title: Fluttering Colours
37b38ddb-450c-8186-9cbd-f07f1245b795.excerpt: Watch technology-enhanced canvases trigger real-time sound and visuals as live painting performance reflects biodiversity and climate change.
37b38ddb-450c-8186-9cbd-f07f1245b795.excerptZh: 科技增强画布在现场绘画中触发实时声像，回应生物多样性与气候变化。

37b38ddb-450c-81e2-9ee2-d7944034f77c.title: Human Variables
37b38ddb-450c-81e2-9ee2-d7944034f77c.excerpt: An endless printer generates genetic data while a projected life story erodes through your interaction, revealing the tension between lived experience and quantified
37b38ddb-450c-81e2-9ee2-d7944034f77c.excerptZh: 打印机不断生成遗传数据，投影中的人生故事随互动消退，呈现生活经验与量化之间的张力。

37b38ddb-450c-8175-afd9-d2629bd6119a.title: A-fetus
37b38ddb-450c-8175-afd9-d2629bd6119a.excerpt: A cybernetic fetus installation reacts to visitor proximity, accelerating or decelerating its projected body to evoke feelings of tranquility.
37b38ddb-450c-8175-afd9-d2629bd6119a.excerptZh: 控制论胎儿装置感应观众距离，改变投影身体的速度，唤起宁静感。

37b38ddb-450c-8182-9670-c51bade3f612.title: In Your Skin
37b38ddb-450c-8182-9670-c51bade3f612.excerpt: An organic, membrane-like body with a responsive technological core activates only in human presence, exposing the creator's authority over artificial life.
37b38ddb-450c-8182-9670-c51bade3f612.excerptZh: 有机薄膜般的身体内含响应技术核心，仅在人类在场时激活，揭示创造者对人工生命的权威。

37b38ddb-450c-817a-aec2-e6e39d40e58b.title: Vacant Spaces, Still Life
37b38ddb-450c-817a-aec2-e6e39d40e58b.excerpt: Krystian Grzywacz’s paired works trace machine perception, exploring technological error and artificial authorship in a dialogue on mediation and absence.
37b38ddb-450c-817a-aec2-e6e39d40e58b.excerptZh: Krystian Grzywacz 的成对作品追踪机器感知，围绕媒介与缺席探索技术错误和人工作者身份。

37b38ddb-450c-8126-94b7-ecc1f29f19ce.title: Hands turned into fingertips, fingertips spiraled into the chaos
37b38ddb-450c-8126-94b7-ecc1f29f19ce.excerpt: This video essay explores how automation and simplified communication intensify complexity and instability in our technologically mediated world.
37b38ddb-450c-8126-94b7-ecc1f29f19ce.titleZh: 手变成指尖，指尖盘旋入混沌
37b38ddb-450c-8126-94b7-ecc1f29f19ce.excerptZh: 影像散文探索自动化与简化交流如何加剧技术媒介世界中的复杂性与不稳定性。

37b38ddb-450c-811c-9438-da387d7e308a.title: Perception of Spheres
37b38ddb-450c-811c-9438-da387d7e308a.excerpt: Manipulate an interactive armillary sphere to navigate a virtual Solar System, where planetary movements generate unique sounds from orbital data and LIGO recordings.
37b38ddb-450c-811c-9438-da387d7e308a.excerptZh: 操作浑天仪探索虚拟太阳系，让行星运动根据轨道数据与 LIGO 录音生成声音。

37b38ddb-450c-81b0-9d26-d7a02a1296a0.title: B-612
37b38ddb-450c-81b0-9d26-d7a02a1296a0.excerpt: A neural network monitors light and humidity to control water distribution for a plant, creating an interdependent relationship between the real and the virtual.
37b38ddb-450c-81b0-9d26-d7a02a1296a0.excerptZh: 神经网络监测光照和湿度，控制植物供水，建立现实与虚拟的相互依存关系。

37b38ddb-450c-819a-8fd0-dea66075bf3b.title: Capital Dream
37b38ddb-450c-819a-8fd0-dea66075bf3b.excerpt: Capital Dream explores neural networks and GPT-2 to highlight voices in media art that have redefined the image and use of technology.
37b38ddb-450c-819a-8fd0-dea66075bf3b.excerptZh: 通过神经网络与 GPT-2，聚焦媒体艺术中重新定义科技形象和用途的声音。

37b38ddb-450c-815a-b3ed-cd34f054105c.title: V.U.S.
37b38ddb-450c-815a-b3ed-cd34f054105c.excerpt: Interact with genomic data in a gray zone where meaning is unresolved, shifting you from passive observer to active decision-maker.
37b38ddb-450c-815a-b3ed-cd34f054105c.excerptZh: 在意义尚未确定的灰色地带与基因组数据互动，从旁观者成为决策者。

37b38ddb-450c-81fa-8235-d0c98a5d64e5.title: STATEMENT
37b38ddb-450c-81fa-8235-d0c98a5d64e5.excerpt: Write slogans on a compostable billboard in this participatory installation that explores equitable futures and sustainable art production.
37b38ddb-450c-81fa-8235-d0c98a5d64e5.excerptZh: 在可堆肥广告牌上写标语，共同探索公平未来与可持续艺术生产。

37b38ddb-450c-8103-ac2c-e2ef785984e8.title: care & action: arts of change – change of arts
37b38ddb-450c-8103-ac2c-e2ef785984e8.excerpt: Artistic methods provide tools to collectively face change, create cohesive communities, and process strong emotions like fear and panic during global crises.
37b38ddb-450c-8103-ac2c-e2ef785984e8.titleZh: 关怀与行动：改变的艺术，艺术的改变
37b38ddb-450c-8103-ac2c-e2ef785984e8.excerptZh: 以艺术方法共同面对变化、凝聚社区，并处理全球危机中的恐惧与惊慌。

37b38ddb-450c-8105-8d02-e2ce0a99acf3.title: HumanMapping
37b38ddb-450c-8105-8d02-e2ce0a99acf3.excerpt: Responsive systems map environmental gestures while floral diagrams metaphorically connect women and flowers in this exhibition on organic and synthetic interactions.
37b38ddb-450c-8105-8d02-e2ce0a99acf3.excerptZh: 响应系统映射环境中的手势，花卉图示隐喻女性与花朵的联系，探索有机与合成互动。

37b38ddb-450c-81e1-9bfd-e1f04a8dbfa1.title: THE LAST ASHES
37b38ddb-450c-81e1-9bfd-e1f04a8dbfa1.excerpt: Watch a speculative 3D film about genetically engineered pets consumed and discarded in collapsed bioengineering ruins.
37b38ddb-450c-81e1-9bfd-e1f04a8dbfa1.excerptZh: 推想式3D电影描绘崩塌的生物工程遗迹中，被消费和遗弃的基因改造宠物。

37b38ddb-450c-8101-be35-f266e80dbb37.title: One More Time
37b38ddb-450c-8101-be35-f266e80dbb37.excerpt: Play a first-person narrative game exploring a young woman’s psychological journey through PTSD as she reconstructs a tragic accident.
37b38ddb-450c-8101-be35-f266e80dbb37.excerptZh: 第一人称叙事游戏跟随年轻女性重构悲剧事故，探索创伤后应激障碍的心理历程。

37b38ddb-450c-8173-86dc-c356adc84dd1.title: The Debate of Two Children
37b38ddb-450c-8173-86dc-c356adc84dd1.excerpt: Watch two digital humans debate a Chinese fable under a red sun while your inputs fuel their contradictory arguments in this interactive installation.
37b38ddb-450c-8173-86dc-c356adc84dd1.excerptZh: 红日之下，两名数字人辩论中国寓言，你的输入不断推动相互矛盾的论点。

37b38ddb-450c-8145-ab9b-dc8927af0df8.title: Co-Breathing

37b38ddb-450c-81f3-b0f0-e03383de65db.title: The System Looks Back

37a38ddb-450c-81c0-ac6c-c9384dd61083.title: AGE OF MONSTERS
37a38ddb-450c-81c0-ac6c-c9384dd61083.excerpt: Five experimental setups reveal how AI and neurotechnologies govern humans by coupling data hunger with predictive models and displaced responsibility.
